title: SNOW
tagline: Interact with web3 using natural language. For easy onboarding, the AI agent guides the person in a friendly manner through wallet creation, money management, coin swapping, and explaining NFTs—anything. It's so easy that even a child can use it to manage their allowance.
description:
Our innovative solution combines the accessibility of AI-driven conversations with the power and potential of web3 interactions, empowering users, especially young individuals, to navigate the web3 space with confidence, save money, and explore exciting opportunities like NFTs while ensuring security and financial growth.

Entering the world of web3 presents several challenges, including Technical Complexity, Lack of User-Friendly Interfaces, and Security Concerns. To address these issues, we've devised a solution that leverages the power of AI-driven friendly conversations and seamless web3 interactions, making it so user-friendly that even a child can use it.

Our solution revolves around an AI chat interface that seamlessly integrates data from Chat GPT. We integrated Metamask SDK for those with existing wallets Additionally, our chat interface can create wallets from scratch. For wallet creation, we've employed ERC-1155 contracts on the Polygon network, ensuring efficient and cost-effective transactions. 1inch API endpoints are integrated for swapping coins.

Metamask SDK
